source.protocol: ScanNet official val_pair, 1860 pairs, 312 scenes, 2 context views,
unposed input, 256x256; the 3D-aware metrics are evaluated on the novel views
source.note: read-only reference values; they are NOT produced by this repository and are
not directly comparable to the 32/8 development numbers here (different split,
different pose input, different metric definitions)

siu3r_without_understanding_to_reconstru.note: the reference method's mask-guided geometry refinement makes the
understanding term complement reconstruction (PSNR +0.45), i.e. its
understanding-vs-reconstruction trade-off is negative-cost, not a sacrifice

reference_training_setting.init: MASt3R ViT-L encoder (frozen during pre-training) + COCO-pre-trained panoptic head

policy_implications_for_this_project.psnr_gate: the -0.20 dB novel-PSNR guard used in the recipe rounds is a self-imposed
engineering threshold, not an SIU3R-protocol threshold; the reference
method shows no PSNR sacrifice, so a mask-guided geometry-refinement style
complementary term (intra-instance depth continuity, lambda ~0.05) belongs
on the strategic option list AFTER a recipe passes the gates
policy_implications_for_this_project.architecture_note: SIU3R's mask is a unified-query 2D mask-logit head (Mask2Former
style) aggregated across views by pixel-aligned Gaussians; this
project's mask medium is token-assignment composited through the
Gaussian renderer, whose measured oracle ceiling on the development
split is 36/55.  If a future arm approaches that ceiling but stays
far below the reference mAP 0.27, the evidence points at the read-out
(direct 2D mask + Gaussian aggregation) rather than at training.
policy_implications_for_this_project.comparison_rule: any 'close to SIU3R' statement must be made from B1 official-evaluator
numbers on the full 1860-pair manifest; development values are
process instruments only.  This model uses GT camera poses to build
rays while SIU3R is unposed, so the input conditions are not equal.
